applicabilityBasis.summary: QCAD is a 1:1 CAD-backed, redeemable stablecoin used for institutional payments and settlement through authorized partners.

genius.licensingRegulator: Ontario Securities Commission / Canadian Securities Administrators; QCAD Digital Trust prospectus and VRCA framework. FINTRAC MSB registration belongs to Stablecorp Digital Currencies Inc., the servicer.
genius.notes: QCAD Digital Trust is the Ontario special-purpose issuer; Stablecorp Digital Currencies Inc. is its administrator/servicer and holds the MSB registration. The Canadian prospectus/VRCA characterization is not a U.S. securities determination or GENIUS authorization. Qualified holders have issuer redemption rights; other end users do not. Legacy QCAD issued before November 20, 2025 is expressly excluded from this trust framework and has separate reserves and redemption arrangements. The monthly-attestation finding concerns trust-scope reports, including the opened archived May report, not all legacy or bridge deployments. No qualifying public U.S. approval, pending application or foreign registration was located. GENIUS issuer implementation remains proposed; U.S. customer eligibility is not established.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of October 7, 2026, the checked issuer disclosures, OCC tracker, NYDFS directory and regulator-domain searches did not identify a qualifying public GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, pending GENIUS application or foreign registration for QCAD/QCAD Digital Trust. Foreign licensing does not satisfy those U.S. requirements. No public U.S. issuer/token enforcement action was located in the specified searches. This finding does not exclude confidential or unindexed filings and does not establish U.S. distribution eligibility.
